chapter: After the Army: JATP, clubs and first Europe trips
title: Switzerland, the Blue Note in Paris, and returning home
summary: He played with Bill Coleman in Bern, did Paris Blue Note with Lil Armstrong and Don Byas, then went home while Bishop stayed.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Switzerland has got the Alps and I used to go play in the Chikita Club in Bern, especially in the winter. And you could just see thousands of people going on up the mountains and everybody's got skis.

Young kids. Special trains to take you up there. And I was playing with Bill Coleman and I'd make that trip almost every week from Paris. I'd leave on Friday night and come back Monday. And during the week I'd play at the Blue Note with Lil Armstrong, Kansas Fields, Don Byas,
we were all in together. Played there for a long time. I played in, oh this was after, later, no in '49 when we came back after being there. I stayed nine months. Bishop never came back.

He's in Holland now. But he has been back. So we came back and stayed. I did some more work with Joe Bushkin, around different people until I went back the next time in '53. For Mezzrow this time for Mezzrow with Big Chief.
